newsitem.title: USA: WALGREENS TO ENTER FIVE SOUTHEAST MARKETS.
newsitem.headline: WALGREENS TO ENTER FIVE SOUTHEAST MARKETS.

text.p: Walgreen Co on Wednesday said it would enter five markets in the southeastern United States next year as part of its plan to open 280 stores in 1998.

The drugstore chain, which had 1996 sales of $11.8 billion, said the new markets are: Charlotte, North Carolina; Tidewater, Virginia; Birmingham, Alabama; Lafayette, Louisiana, and Jackson, Mississippi.

The company said it would open five stores in Charlotte, four in Tidewater and two or three in Birmingham next summer. It will also open the first Walgreens stores in Jackson and Lafayette next spring.

After the 280 openings next year, Walgreens said it planned to open nearly one store each day in 1999, with the goal of operating 3,000 stores by the year 2000. Walgreens currently operates 2,321 stores in 34 states and Puerto Rico.
